title: Implement Light Mode and Theme Toggle Switcher with State Persistence
description: Design and implement a museum-grade Light Mode version of Frame Cottage (warm gallery canvas #FAF8F5, pristine white surfaces, deep charcoal typography, burgundy & gold accents) alongside the existing Dark Mode (#1A1A1A). Add an accessible Theme Toggle button in the header with local storage persistence and zero-flicker hydration.
acceptanceCriteria: globals.css defines responsive theme variables for both Light Mode (:root with #FAF8F5 canvas, #1A1A1A text) and Dark Mode (.dark with #1A1A1A canvas, #F4F1EA text)
ThemeToggle button with Sun/Moon icons implemented and integrated into SiteHeader and MobileNav
Theme preference persists across page reloads via localStorage without hydration mismatch flicker
All page sections (Header, Hero Carousel, Custom Frame Studio, Pills, Trust Bar, Collections, Journey, Atelier, Lookbook, FAQ, Footer) render gracefully in both Light and Dark modes
Playwright test suite updated to test theme toggling between Light and Dark modes with 100% pass rate
Screenshots captured in both modes: task-11-light-mode.png and task-11-dark-mode.png

steps.description: Configure Light Mode and Dark Mode CSS custom properties in globals.css and layout.tsx
steps.details: Set :root to Light Mode (#FAF8F5 base, #FFFFFF surfaces, #1A1A1A text, #E5DFD5 borders) and .dark to Dark Mode (#1A1A1A base, #242424 surfaces, #F4F1EA text). Add anti-flicker inline script in layout.tsx.

steps.description: Build ThemeToggle component and mount in SiteHeader and MobileNav
steps.details: Create components/theme/theme-toggle.tsx with Sun/Moon animated transition, localStorage sync, and mount in SiteHeader and MobileNav.

steps.description: Harmonize all page components for dual Light and Dark mode rendering
steps.details: Ensure headers, cards, carousels, frame visualizer, sliders, lookbook pins, and footer render with high contrast and polish in both modes.

steps.description: Write Playwright tests for theme switching and capture verification screenshots
steps.details: Create tests/theme-toggle.spec.ts, run all Playwright tests, and capture task-11-light-mode.png and task-11-dark-mode.png.
